items.text: Compromise a low-value internal 'feature flag' microservice via a default credential → its service account has broad IAM read access to the secrets manager → extract the primary database's connection string

SSRF into an internal 'notification dispatcher' service → the service holds a long-lived service-mesh mTLS-adjacent bearer token accepted by every internal service → replay the token against the billing service directly

Compromise the internal admin-tooling service (weak auth, forgotten from a migration) → its outbound webhook signing key is shared with the production API's webhook verifier → forge production-trusted webhook events from the compromised internal service
